objective.statement: Teach Codex root to orchestrate delegated Codex CLI work through explicit gateway profiles.
objective.measure: The external-harness skill names the orchestration role, all five external profiles, and the ephemeral one-shot command.

need.statement: The existing skill documents Kimi CLI and Cursor but not the installed Codex gateway profiles.
need.baseline: The focused contract test has no assertion for explicit Codex external profiles.
need.consequence_of_no_action: Codex may launch external CLI work without an explicit role profile or fail to state that root orchestrates it.
assumptions: The operator-provided profile names and command forms are authoritative.
alternatives_considered: Extend the existing canonical external-harness skill

purpose: Make Codex root consistently orchestrate delegated Codex CLI work through explicit gateway profiles.
consumer: Codex root sessions launching bounded external Codex CLI tasks.
contract: When Codex root delegates through the Codex CLI, it identifies itself as orchestrator, uses the session-bound repo_memory coordination_* API tier for task status, selects exactly one external-explorer, external-worker, external-reasoner, external-reviewer, or external-verifier profile by role, and uses codex exec --ephemeral --profile <profile> for one-shot tasks.
failure_boundary: Do not change profile definitions, provider routing, publication authority, or the existing Kimi/Cursor launch contracts.

evidence.description: The focused Node contract test fails before the skill names the explicit profiles and passes afterward.

falsifier.claim: The installed skill teaches explicit profile-based orchestration.

executable_check.description: A missing orchestration role, profile name, or ephemeral one-shot command falsifies the claim.

non_goals: Changing Kimi CLI or Cursor commands
invariants: Codex root remains coordinator, verifier, and sole publisher
Codex root uses the session-bound repo_memory coordination_* API tier for task status and never the retired swarm_bus_* API
Every delegated Codex CLI invocation uses an explicit external-* profile
Home Manager remains the deployment authority for ~/.codex

assumptions.statement: The five operator-provided external profile names are installed and canonical.
assumptions.falsifier: The tracked profile mappings or live ~/.codex profile files omit any named profile.

plane_constraints: Edit the tracked Home Manager source; do not hand-edit ~/.codex projections.
